text: A scalable topic (PIP-460) is a DAG of hash-range segments, each one managed ledger, split and merged without breaking key order. The controller (PIP-468) owns layout and assignment; auto split/merge is PIP-483; consumers are stream, queue and checkpoint, with key-shared buckets in PIP-486; the V5 client is PIP-466; the contract is spec/scalable-topics.
